identificationModule.briefTitle: Selumetinib (AZD6244: ARRY-142886) (Hyd-Sulfate) in Metastatic Uveal Melanoma (SUMIT)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomised, Double-Blind Study to Assess the Efficacy of Selumetinib (AZD6244: ARRY-142886) (Hyd-Sulfate) in Combination With Dacarbazine Compared With Placebo in Combination With Dacarbazine as First Systemic Therapy in Patients With Metastatic Uveal Melanoma (SUMIT)

armGroups.label: selumetinib 75mg twice daily
armGroups.description: selumetinib 75mg twice daily in combination with dacarbazine.

armGroups.label: placebo twice daily
armGroups.description: placebo twice daily in combination with dacarbazine.

interventions.name: 75mg selumetinib
interventions.description: selumetinib tablets p.o. twice daily taken in combination with dacarbazine 1000mg/m2 iv on day 1 of every 21-day cycle.

interventions.name: placebo
interventions.description: placebo tablets p.o. twice daily taken in combination with dacarbazine 1000mg/m2 iv on day 1 of every 21-day cycle.

interventions.name: Dacarbazine
interventions.description: dacarbazine 1000mg/m2 iv on day 1 of every 21-day cycle taken in combination with either selumetinib or placebo tablets p.o. twice daily.
